summary: Iteration 6 — tested 5 features requested by main agent (Notification Deep Links, Workout History on Activity, Real Podcast Progress, Confetti moments, Mini-Player positioning). Backend pytest 20/20 pass (added 2 new tests: activity/log with title populates workouts array on /activity/daily; POST /podcasts/:id/listen increments user.podcastSessionsCompleted). Frontend flows verified on 390x900 mobile viewport across two Playwright runs (backend re-seeded between runs). Verified: (a) Notifications sheet opens from Dashboard bell, all 3 deep-links route correctly — n1->/profile with auto-scroll to #friends-leaderboard-section (bbox_y=244 in viewport), n2->/dashboard + opens add-action-modal-overlay, n3->/wellness/podcast; unread dot for n2 disappears after tap. (b) Workout History section renders below metric tiles on /activity with empty state 'No workouts logged yet today...'; after Add Workout (FAB->action-add-workout->preset-0->submit) a card 'Walk 20 min 20 mins 90 kcal' appears in todays-workout-item-0 without reload (TanStack Query invalidation working). (c) Podcast listen POST -> counter increments verified via API after clicking daily-pick play button (seeded 2 -> observed 3 after 1 listen). (d) Water threshold: 5x action-add-drink from seeded 750ml crossed to waterMl=2000 (verified via GET /activity/daily), confetti canvas visible in screenshot on podcast page. (e) AchievementsModal after crossing 3 podcast sessions: status='Unlocked' for mindful-master, 'Milestone Unlocked' toast text present in DOM. Mini-player positioning previously fixed in iteration_5 (verified in run 1: fits within 390px viewport and does not overlap FAB, controls visible and clickable, hidden on /wellness/podcast route).

ui_bugs.issue: Dynamic subtitle displays raw counter without capping at the goal — after listening more than 3 podcast sessions the badge shows '4/3 podcast sessions completed' (or higher). Once status is Unlocked the numerator should be capped at 3 (or the subtitle should switch to a completed-state string).

action_items: Minor: cap Mindful Master subtitle numerator at the goal (Math.min(count, 3)) so it never renders '4/3', '5/3', etc. after unlock — purely a display polish.

Optional: consider making POST /api/v1/podcasts/:id/listen idempotent per-track-per-session (right now every click of the daily-pick play button increments the counter, so pause+resume or navigate-away+return can inflate the counter). If the intent is 'unique sessions', tracking which podcasts have already been counted this day would be more accurate.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /api/v1/podcasts/:id/listen correctly increments User.podcastSessionsCompleted and echoes the new value back — frontend AudioPlayerContext consumes it via useLogPodcastListen so React Query cache stays in sync.

ActivityLog.workouts subdocument array + addWorkoutEntry $push + concurrent $inc on aggregate fields is a clean single-write operation; getDaily maps to a stable client-facing shape (title/caloriesBurned/activeMinutes/distanceKm/loggedAt).

NotificationsSheet correctly closes and navigates via state passed through react-router (scrollToLeaderboard state consumed by UserProfile), and the QuickActions deep-link is triggered via a shared UI store/context that survives the navigation.

celebration.ts using canvas-confetti with dual burst + brand color palette is nicely isolated; consumers (useLogWater with cross-goal guard, useLogWorkout on success, achievements newly-unlocked branch) call it declaratively.
Mini-player positioning (left-4 right-4 mx-auto, hidden on /wellness/podcast) — verified functional in iteration_5; still correct here.

success_rate.frontend: 13/15 assertions across two runs (1 minor UI cap bug on Mindful Master numerator, 1 flaky mini-player render after multiple toggle+navigation cycles — mini-player positioning itself verified correct on both /dashboard first-play and hidden on /wellness/podcast)

seed_data_creation: Re-ran `cd /app/server && npx ts-node src/seed.ts` twice to reset demo data between runs (resets podcastSessionsCompleted to 2, clears today's workouts, waterMl back to 750).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 features from this batch pass end-to-end. Backend endpoints in play: POST /api/v1/activity/log with body {title,caloriesBurned,activeMinutes,distanceKm} pushes into workouts array AND increments aggregates in one write; POST /api/v1/podcasts/:id/listen returns {podcastSessionsCompleted:N}. Frontend data-testids in use: dashboard-notifications-button, profile-notifications-button, notifications-sheet, notification-{n1,n2,n3}, notification-unread-dot-{id}, add-action-modal-overlay, friends-leaderboard-section (id, not data-testid), todays-workouts-section, todays-workouts-empty-state, todays-workout-item-0, action-{add-drink,add-workout}, add-workout-preset-{0,1,2}, add-workout-submit-button, achievement-badge-mindful-master, achievement-status-mindful-master, mini-player + mini-player-{title,toggle-button,close-button}, podcast-daily-pick-play-button, podcast-track-{id}. localStorage key vitality_unlocked_badges controls first-time-unlock celebration. Note: podcast listen increment is not idempotent per session — every play-button click POSTs.
rca_of_the_issue: Mindful Master '4/3' subtitle RCA: AchievementsModal renders `${user.podcastSessionsCompleted}/${goal}` verbatim. Since POST /podcasts/:id/listen increments unconditionally on every play-button click and the frontend never caps the displayed numerator, once the user crosses the goal the fraction can exceed 1 (e.g. 4/3, 5/3). Mitigation (one-line frontend fix): `Math.min(user.podcastSessionsCompleted, 3)/3` when badge is unlocked, or hide the fraction entirely once status='Unlocked'.
